body.p: Summary of Interview

On December 10, 2024, the undersigned (Craig Summerfield) and Examiner Bao Long T. Nguyen discussed independent claims 1, 7, and 13 in view of the prior art. Examiner Nguyen indicated that he would consider the remarks. To expedite prosecution and save costs, Applicants amend the claims to take allowable subject matter.
Remarks
Claims 1-18 are pending, including independent claims 1, 7, and 13.
Claims 5, 11, and 17 are cancelled.
Claims 5-6, 11, and 17-18 were objected to as allowable in independent form. Claims 6 was rejected for 112 grounds, not based on prior art.
Applicants request reconsideration of the rejections of claims 1-4, 6-10, and 12-16.
Claims 6, 9, and 12 were rejected pursuant to 35 U.S.C. §112(b) as indefinite. Claims 6, 9, and 12 are corrected without narrowing.
Claims 1-4, 7-10, and 13-16 were rejected pursuant to the judicially created
doctrine of double patenting over claims 1-8, 13-15, and 17-18 of U.S. Patent No. 11,589,931 in view of Kottenstette (US 2021/0220064).
Independent claim 1 is amended with the limitations of claim 5, which is not rejected under the judicially created doctrine of double patenting.
Independent claim 7 is amended with the limitations of claim1 1, which is not rejected under the judicially created doctrine of double patenting.
Independent claim 13 is amended with the limitations of claim 17, which is not rejected under the judicially created doctrine of double patenting.
Claims 1-4 and 7-10 were rejected pursuant to 35 U.S.C. §103 as unpatentable

over Kottenstette (US 2021/0220064) in view of Vasilenko (US 2017/0147819) and Gamer (US 2015/0293779). Claims 13-14 and 16 were rejected pursuant to 35 U.S.C. §103 as unpatentable over Kottenstette in view of Gamer. Claim 15 was rejected pursuant to 35
U.S.C. §103 as unpatentable over Kottenstette in view of Gamer, and further in view of Vasilenko.
While the independent claims are allowable for other reasons, the independent claims are amended with the limitations of allowable claims to save costs and expedite prosecution.
Independent claim 1 is amended with the limitations of allowable claim 5. There are no intervening claims, so claim 1 is allowable.
Independent claim 7 is amended with the limitations of allowable claim 11. There are no intervening claims, so claim 7 is allowable.
Independent claim 13 is amended with the limitations of allowable claim 17. There are no intervening claims, so claim 13 is allowable.

Dependent claims 2-5, 8-10, 21-24, and 26 depend from the independent claims so are allowable for the same reasons as the respective base claim. Further limitation patentably distinguish from the cited references.
Applicants respectfully submit that all the pending claims are in condition for

allowance and seeks early allowance thereof. If for any reason, the Examiner is unable to allow the application in the next Office Action and believes that an interview would be helpful to resolve any remaining issues, he is respectfully requested to contact the undersigned attorneys at (312) 321-4200.
Respectfully submitted,
Craig A. Summerfield
Registration No. 37,947
Attorney for Applicants
Dated: December 17, 2024
